acceptance_contribution_scope.expectation: EVAL-01 retains global export/sandbox/reporting scope; this handoff is contribution only.

consumer_error_ack_retry.expectation: Define safe rejection, acknowledgement and retry behavior for incompatible/stale/untrusted inputs.

correction_invalidation_identity_and_his.expectation: Correction identifies affected downstream artifacts; invalidation is idempotent and history is retained.

external_approval_authority.expectation: Product owns authenticated scope and approval authority; consumer must fail closed on untrusted claims.

locked_facts_unresolved_questions.expectation: Keep locked facts and unresolved questions visible to consumer behavior.

package_identity_version_hash.expectation: Consumer carries package ID, version and hash unchanged.

permitted_asset_identity_hash_scope_expi.expectation: Carry permission-bound asset identity/hash/scope/expiry/revocation or original-artwork fallback.

program_epic_reference.expectation: Point to the sole harness coordinator epic; links/closure are not executable evidence.

trace_decision_usage_references.expectation: Preserve trace, decision and usage references without claiming provider success.

actual_consumer_revision_not_local_doubl.expected: agreed representative fixture runs on the actual pinned consumer; a local double is insufficient

corrected_package_invalidation_is_idempo.expected: corrected package invalidates affected artifacts idempotently and retains history

preserves_package_identity_locked_facts_.expected: consumer preserves package ID/version/hash, locked facts and unresolved questions

rejects_incompatible_scope_unresolved_or.expected: consumer rejects incompatible schema, forged scope, unresolved required fact and stale/revoked approval

rights_assets_or_original_artwork_fallba.expected: consumer preserves asset identity/hash/scope/expiry/revocation or explicit original-artwork fallback

trace_decision_usage_and_sponsor_refs_ar.expected: consumer preserves trace/decision/usage references; scoped EVAL contribution is not whole-criterion proof

billable_attempt_id.expectation: Billable attempt identity is distinct from transport retry.

billing_mode.expectation: billing_mode is explicit and does not itself prove billing.

correction_fields.expectation: External owner decides correction fields, revision semantics and history behavior.

correlation_id.expectation: correlation_id links the approved execution context.

event_id.expectation: event_id identifies an emitted event, not occurrence identity or package identity.

invalidation_fields.expectation: External owner decides invalidation identity, ordering and deduplication fields.

logical_operation_id.expectation: Logical operation identity is distinct from attempts and source observation.

noul_confidence.expectation: Noul has only type and noul; no confidence field.

package_alias.expectation: Decide the EventIntelligencePackage/ResearchPackage alias; this catalog does not choose the wire name.

permitted_asset_wire_field.expectation: permittedAssets is conceptual only; external owner decides exact wire field.

producer_build_revision.expectation: Record producer/build revision; exact composite field spelling remains for owner review.

project_id.expectation: project_id is an externally authenticated scope value.

provider_request_id.expectation: Provider request identity may be absent and is distinct from local identities.

receipt_fields.expectation: External owner decides request/answer/batch receipt fields and typed errors.

schema_version.expectation: schema_version is required; pin supported compatibility policy.

scope_approval_fields.expectation: Issuer/audience/actor/tenant/project/asset version/hash/use/expiry/revocation and trusted lookup/signature rule require Product-owned agreement.

score_legend.expectation: EI v1 keeps Score criteria/legend string-only pending the official discrepancy decision.

source_observation_identity.expectation: Decide exact source observation identity field and duplicate semantics.

tenant_id.expectation: tenant_id is an externally authenticated scope value.

transport_attempt_id.expectation: Transport attempt identity is distinct from billable attempt.

choice_score_noul_shapes_and_noul_has_no.expected: real generated bindings parse valid Choice/Score/Noul and reject missing/extra/invalid fields

compatibility_minor_additive_and_unknown.expected: supported old minor/additive fields follow reviewed rule; unknown major returns typed error

crosswalk_identity_and_canonical_binding.expected: producer and consumer generated bindings compare canonical bytes/hashes and preserve distinct identities

dependency_graph_has_no_engine_harness_i.expected: contract-layer imports are acyclic and no engine imports the complete harness package

dependent_questions_use_separate_stages.expected: identity then support assessment uses immutable separate batches without sibling reads

official_score_legend_discrepancy_decisi.expected: record the official Score legend discrepancy decision; retain string-only criteria/legend until owners decide

package_uncertainty_asset_policy_and_inv.expected: representative package preserves facts/uncertainty, source and transformed hashes, policy, refs and ordered invalidation identity

timeouts_abstentions_malformed_results_p.expected: timeout, abstention and malformed result leave eligible capability set unchanged

trusted_approval_fails_closed.expected: trusted mechanism rejects forged issuer, wrong scope/hash/version/use, expiry/revocation and boolean claims

billable_attempt_id.expectation: A genuinely new billable attempt remains distinct under retries.

consume_release.expectation: Define consume/release semantics and conservation rules.

event_observation_identity.expectation: event_id and observation identity are distinct and dedupe is specified.

exact_amount_currency.expectation: Use exact amount and currency; no rounding or currency is assumed here.

logical_operation_id.expectation: Logical operation is distinct from billable and transport attempts.

predispatch_authorization.expectation: Define authorization immediately before dispatch and revocation behavior.

provider_request_id.expectation: Missing provider request ID has an explicit representation.

rate_card_version_effective_date.expectation: Record rate-card version/source and effective date when known.

research_reuse_allocation.expectation: EI emits original usage lineage and reuse telemetry; Finance owns allocation.

reserve.expectation: Define owner, action, blocker and authoritative state for reservation.

trace_delivery_ack_recovery.expectation: Define acknowledgement, durable delivery, retry and reconciliation boundaries.

transport_attempt_id.expectation: SDK/transport retries are mapped per provider and may be nonbillable.

unknown_inflight_outcome.expectation: Unknown in-flight cost remains held until external reconciliation.

valuation.expectation: Unknown, estimated and provider-confirmed are distinct; unknown is never zero.

worker_lease.expectation: Worker lease expiry/restart is never a financial reservation expiry signal.

cache_reuse_keeps_original_charge_lineag.expected: cache reuse references original research usage and adds no research charge

competing_reservations_only_one_uses_las.expected: two competing reservations cannot both consume the final capacity

duplicate_direct_and_trace_observation_d.expected: duplicate direct/trace observation dedupes by agreed identity

new_billable_attempt_is_retained.expected: second billable execution remains a distinct attempt for one logical operation

timeout_cancel_restart_hold_until_reconc.expected: unknown in-flight outcome holds capacity through timeout/cancel/restart until reconciliation

trace_outage_is_durable_or_fails_closed.expected: trace outage uses bounded durable delivery or fail-closed dispatch, never silent loss

unused_predispatch_capacity_releases_saf.expected: known unused pre-dispatch capacity follows reviewed release semantics

account_project_eligibility.expectation: Record account/project eligibility; never expose credentials.

budget_owner_and_revocation.expectation: Finance owns budget authority and pre-dispatch revocation checks.

dependency_mode.expectation: Classify simulated, recorded, sandbox or live separately.

explicit_model_id_version.expectation: Record explicit model ID/version; do not substitute latest or auto.

gpt_image_readiness_owner.expectation: Creative and fulfillment owns GPT Image readiness as a separate provider surface.

neatlogs_readiness_owner.expectation: Agent and research records Neatlogs separately as a harness-owned related surface.

parameters_retry_limit.expectation: Record parameters and retry limit without inferred defaults.

provider_identity.expectation: Record provider and endpoint/API version only after owner verification.

rate_card_source_effective_date.expectation: Record source and effective date when verified; no prices are assumed.

runtime_sdk.expectation: Record actual runtime and SDK version; no value is selected here.

usage_basis_and_reference.expectation: Separate unknown, estimated and provider-confirmed usage; unknown is not zero.

budget_revocation_rechecked_before_dispa.expected: budget permission revoked after readiness is revalidated before dispatch

dependency_modes_and_sanitized_refs_are_.expected: simulated/recorded/sandbox/live are distinguished with redacted provider and usage references

explicit_model_pin_has_no_latest_substit.expected: unavailable explicit model pin fails rather than substituting a moving latest alias

missing_access_model_or_budget_blocks_be.expected: missing/revoked access, unavailable explicit model or absent budget blocks before billable dispatch

readiness_is_nonbillable_or_limitation_i.expected: readiness records accessible metadata without inference, or states no safe check exists
